caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing female figure mounted on a multi-tiered, rectangular base. The figure wears a green dress and brown footwear, and has a red headscarf or cap. The female figure holds a bundle of brooms in her left arm and a torch-like object raised in her right hand. The base is mottled with shades of brown and beige, giving it the appearance of aged stone or metal. The background of the image is plain and off-white, and there is a faint signature near the lower right corner that reads "ANDREW TOPOLOSKY." The overall composition centers the statue against the blank background, with the statue rendered in naturalistic colors.
